headwords.text: To dream of peppermint, denotes pleasant entertainments and interesting affairs. To see it growing, denotes that you will participate in some pleasure in which there will be a dash of romance. To enjoy drinks in which there is an effusion of peppermint, denotes that you will enjoy assignations with some attractive and fascinating person. To a young woman, this dream warns her against seductive pleasures.
To dream that you are in a perspiration, foretells that you will come out of some difficulty, which has caused much gossip, with new honors.
headwords.note: 이미 있는 `sweat`(땀, 주공해몽 「몸에 땀이 흐름」, 흉)와 같은 그림(땀이 남)인데 밀러는 길(새 영예)로 정반대라 통째로 건너뛴다
